annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Directive amending Council Directive 98/58/EC and Directive 2009/128/EC as regards the simplification and strengthening of food and feed safety requirements, and repealing Council Directives 82/711/EEC and 85/572/EEC
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Directive amending Council Directive 98/58/EC and Directive 2009/128/EC as regards the simplification and strengthening of food and feed safety requirements, and repealing Council Directives 82/711/EEC and 85/572/EEC
annotation.summary_en: European Commission omnibus proposal (December 2025) simplifying food and feed safety law. It amends the Sustainable Use of Pesticides Directive to let Member States exempt certain risk-assessed drones from the aerial spraying ban, subject to delegated acts and pesticide authorisation. It also removes duplicate animal record-keeping and repeals two obsolete plastics directives.
key_provisions_or_claims: New Article 9a lets Member States exempt specified unmanned aircraft systems from the aerial spraying ban for professional users.
Commission must adopt a delegated act within 4 years identifying drone types with risks equal to or lower than land-based equipment.
Pesticides must be explicitly authorised for drone application under Regulation 1107/2009; EFSA to develop risk assessment guidance.
Drone use remains subject to EU drone rules on remote pilot competence and operational limits.
Deletes duplicate record-keeping in Directive 98/58/EC and repeals Directives 82/711/EEC and 85/572/EEC.
